m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You feed the algae to the starfish on the gate. </ITALICS>
So this is the intruder who dares enter our realm? What a jest! You don’t even have a soft shell!
Argh! You’ve cracked my shell but good! Take the wretched stone! It’s never brought me any luck!
<ITALICS>The Governor drops the other piece of the Stellarium portal. </ITALICS>
What’s that? You’ve recovered two pieces of the Stellarium portal stone? Smashing!
If Optio Misemos told you the truth, the next step is to gather enough algae to feed the creature.
The Crustacean Waverunners are always carrying little pots full of algae, presumably for the Starfish.
If you defeat a few Crustacean Waverunners and take their algae, I’ll wager you’ll be able to spring that gate open right quick!
Once you get the Starfish Gate open, that missing piece of the Stellarium portal is bound to be somewhere past it!
Then, you should probably just take both pieces back to Dalton Prescott, in the Promenade. No need to risk them down here!
You were on your way to defeat the Crustacean Waverunners and take their algae.
Feed it to the Starfish, and then recover the Stellarium portal piece. Then head back to the Promenade!
